description: Create a comment trigger. Creates a trigger. It goes live at once unless the plan's live-trigger cap is reached, in which case it is saved paused and created_paused is true (never refused). Any DM mode needs at least one button, up to three; Meta requires a button on a comment-triggered DM. Story and Live triggers are Instagram only and never post-scoped. Send draft: true to save an incomplete trigger paused, skipping the template and button requirements. It goes live at once and starts DMing real commenters. Confirm with the user first, or send draft: true to save it paused. A paused trigger stays paused through edits until you send active: true.

buttons.description: Buttons under the DM. At least one is required for any DM mode, three at most.

response.description: text buttons: the message sent when tapped. Required for text.

title.description: Button label, 20 characters max (a Meta limit).

url.description: url buttons: where the button opens. Required for url.

dm_ai_goal.description: What the AI-written DM should achieve.

dm_file_url.description: https PDF attached to the DM.

dm_image_url.description: https image attached to the DM.

dm_templates.description: Up to five DM variations. Required when the mode includes a DM unless dm_use_ai is true.

dm_use_ai.description: Let the AI write the DM from dm_ai_goal, the knowledge base and the configured tone. Needs dm_ai_goal.

draft.description: Save incomplete, paused. Skips the template and button requirements.

exclude_keywords.description: If any of these appear the trigger does not fire.

hide_comment_after_dm.description: Hide the comment once the DM is sent (post comments only).

match_type.description: exact = whole word; contains = anywhere in the text; fuzzy = tolerates a typo or two.

post_id.description: Scope to one post (an id from GET /recent-posts). Null means every post. Ignored for story and live.

post_url.description: Label only; post_id is what scopes the trigger.

public_replies.description: Up to five variations, one is picked per fire. {name} is the commenter. Required when the mode includes a public reply.

response_mode.description: both = public reply and DM; public_only; dm_only.

source_type.description: comment = post and Reel comments; story = replies to your stories; both = either; live = comments during an Instagram Live. story and live are Instagram only.

tag_id.description: Tag applied to the commenter when the trigger fires. Pro plans and above; silently ignored below.

name: create_comment_trigger
